**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast tray with toast, avocado, fried eggs, a latte, a lemon wedge and two butter portions. It is photographed from the front at a slightly elevated angle.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The right-hand paper plate, about 18 cm across, is the ruler. Its area is 3.14 × 9² ≈ 254 cm². The toast sits on a separate plate, so I size its pieces against the same 18 cm scale.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Toast (2 slices), avocado half, 2 fried eggs, lemon wedge, latte, 2 butter portions.

**STEP 4 - Area (of the 18 cm plate):** Avocado ~15% (~38 cm²), eggs ~22% (~56 cm²). Toast ~120 cm² on its own plate; lemon ~5 cm²; butter ~ 2 packets of ~10 g.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Avocado: 38 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 95 ml
- Eggs: 56 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 84 ml
- Toast: two slices, each ~1 cm thick, sized by the ~30 g per slice typical of sliced bread (the 0.9 density rule would overestimate a slice this thin)
- Lemon wedge: ~10 g
- Latte: ~200 ml in the mug
- Butter: ~20 g total

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Avocado: 95 ml × 0.6 ≈ 57 g
- Eggs: ~100 g (two fried eggs, ~50 g each)
- Toast: ~60 g (two slices)
- Lemon: ~10 g
- Latte: ~200 g
- Butter: ~20 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Avocado: 57 g × 160 kcal/100 g ≈ 91 kcal
- Fried egg: 100 g × 196 kcal/100 g ≈ 196 kcal
- Toast: 60 g × 270 kcal/100 g ≈ 162 kcal
- Lemon: 10 g × 29 kcal/100 g ≈ 3 kcal
- Whole-milk latte: 200 g × 55 kcal/100 g ≈ 110 kcal (any sugar not visible)
- Butter: 20 g × 717 kcal/100 g ≈ 143 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 447 g and 705 kcal. That is plausible for a full breakfast of two toast slices, two eggs, half an avocado, a latte and butter. The main uncertainties are the latte volume and the fat in the eggs.
